alerts.reason: Hershey’s year-over-year net sales decline narrowed from 16.70% in June to 1.40% in September. That recovery supports a December forecast above −5%. Volume fell about 3% across segments (B), and consumer demand continued to weaken (D). I forecast that further volume losses will push reported net sales growth to −5% or lower in the quarter starting December 30.

Cree’s reported revenue fell 0.99% year over year in June and 1.37% in September (A and historical sales). Those shallow declines support a December forecast above −5%. Industrial and energy demand was softening (D), while the EV demand growth cited in B was mid- to long-term. I forecast that sustained industrial and energy weakness will take reported revenue growth to −5% or lower in the quarter starting December 30.
